description: Defines a static class HTMLPurifier_Encoder responsible for cleaning, encoding, and converting UTF-8 strings, including character encoding transformations and validation techniques.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Encoder
classes.description: A static class providing methods for UTF-8 string cleaning, encoding, decoding, and character conversion, with support for validation and ASCII conversion.

methods.name: cleanUTF8
methods.description: Sanitizes a UTF-8 string to ensure well-formedness and SGML validity by removing control characters and invalid sequences.

methods.name: unichr
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point into its UTF-8 character equivalent.

methods.name: convertToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a string from a specified character encoding to UTF-8, using iconv if available.

methods.name: convertFromUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to a specified character encoding, with options for lossless ASCII conversion.

methods.name: convertToASCIIDumbLossless
methods.description: Transforms a UTF-8 string into ASCII with non-ASCII characters represented as numeric entities.

methods.name: testEncodingSupportsASCII
methods.description: Tests whether a given encoding supports ASCII and returns character mappings for iconv conversions.
